entries.source: blind sample e3d282da, H7 fit (complex, 0.05-1.05 s, 0.6 1/s, signal weighting); identity confirmed by the user
entries.conditions: pure, in water (pH not given); NMRduino averaged FID, 4000 Hz
entries.notes: Fit amplitudes 1 : 0.39 (natural 1 : 1); small couplings drift with the model (H7 vs self-consistent alanine).

entries.source: blind sample b683220d, H7 fit with free amplitudes (complex, 0.05-1.05 s, 0.6 1/s, signal weighting with envelope cores); identity confirmed by the user
entries.conditions: solvent and pH not given; NMRduino averaged FID, 4000 Hz
entries.notes: Fit amplitudes 1 : 1.04. H7 plus one weakly coupled proton (H8) fits better; with it J(Ha,Hb) 7.06, J(Ca,Hb) -4.69, J(Cb,Ha) -4.40 Hz.

entries.source: blind sample fde3fbb2, automatic zulf_hypothesis run (motif CH2-CH2, free amplitudes; complex, 0.05-1.05 s, 0.6 1/s, signal weighting); identity confirmed by the user
entries.conditions: solvent and pH not given; NMRduino averaged FID, 4000 Hz; N-H exchange assumed fast (not modelled)
entries.notes: Fit left large unexplained structure (reduced chi2 about 810); small couplings provisional.

entries.source: blind sample 4322bdfc, reduced N-ethyl fragment refined after the identity was given (fixed natural-abundance ratios, shared rate; complex, 0.05-1.05 s, 0.6 1/s, signal weighting); identity confirmed by the user
entries.conditions: solvent not given; NMRduino averaged FID, 4000 Hz; reduced model (other N-CH2 protons as one group, remote methyls dropped)
entries.notes: Reduced chi2 about 430; the 13CH2 isotopologue is weak and poorly fitted; small couplings provisional.

entries.source: blind sample e66a4b08, known-structure fit after the identity was given (fast N-H exchange, fixed natural ratios, shared rate; complex, 0.05-1.05 s, 0.6 1/s, signal weighting); identity confirmed by the user
entries.conditions: solvent and pH not given; NMRduino averaged FID, 4000 Hz; N-H exchange treated as fast
entries.notes: Fit well above noise (reduced chi2 about 270); per-isotopologue rates or a slow-exchange NH lower it; J(C2,HC3) not determined (3.9-6.6 Hz across variants).
